# Pull Request

- **Title**: Concise summary of the change
- **Related Issue**: Closes #<issue-number> (if applicable)

## Summary

Describe what this PR does and why.

## Changes

- [ ] Feature/bugfix summary 1
- [ ] Summary 2

## Screenshots / Demos

If UI changes, add screenshots or a short video/gif.

## Testing

Describe how you tested this change locally. Include commands or steps.

## Checklist

- [ ] I updated documentation/README where necessary
- [ ] I ran `npm run lint` and fixed issues
- [ ] I verified `.env` and secrets are not committed
- [ ] I tested on a clean install (`rm -rf node_modules && npm i`)
